title: 'To bring more clarity': Centre issues FAQs after oppn red flags GDP figures
content: The government released FAQs to explain its GDP estimation methods.  This clarification addresses opposition concerns regarding recent growth figures.  The government said the updated annual and quarterly GDP estimates, based on the 2022-23 base year, were released on August 31 using new data sources and methodologies, including the new series of the Output Producer Price Index (PPI) and Banking Services Price Index.

title: 'It's God's order': Ram Temple CEO & war hero Mishra welcomes chance to serve nation
content: Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra has been appointed the first chief executive officer of the Trust. He expressed gratitude for the opportunity to serve the nation after his military career. Mishra views his selection as a blessing and hopes to contribute to the temple's service. The new role involves overseeing administrative and operational functions for the expanding Trust. His family is immensely pleased with his new national service assignment.

title: India to host inaugural ICC Women’s Champions Trophy; Check teams, dates and venues
content: India will host the inaugural ICC Women's Champions Trophy in 2027. The six-team tournament will be played in the T20I format across two venues. Sri Lanka lost hosting rights due to governance concerns, leading to India's successful bid. Qualified teams include India, Australia, England, New Zealand, South Africa, and Sri Lanka. This event signifies a new chapter for women's international cricket.

title: 'Reprehensible act of vandalism': India flays Pak over demolition of old Hindu temple
content: India voiced deep concern over the reported destruction of a historic Hindu temple. The Ministry of External Affairs condemned the vandalism against the century-old place of worship. India noted the apparent apathy of authorities and failure to protect the temple. The government called for a prompt and transparent investigation into the incident. Pakistan must take remedial measures to restore the temple and ensure minority safety.

title: Months after Dell's $6.25B pledge, Trump Accounts get new rules
content: The new guidance from the US Treasury simplifies payroll contributions for child savings accounts, allowing employers to contribute up to $2,500 annually for employee dependents, free from taxes. Employees can also make pre-tax contributions directly. This initiative is backed by a generous $6.25 billion commitment from the Michael and Susan Dell Foundation, with more than fifty companies already on board.

title: 8 wickets in 4 Innings, Yet former India WK-batter urges team to look beyond Ravindra Jadeja
content: Former wicketkeeper Deep Dasgupta advocates for India's cricket team to explore options beyond veteran all-rounder Ravindra Jadeja. He reflected on Jadeja's recent performance in Sri Lanka and found it lacking efficiency. Dasgupta also highlighted the noteworthy talent of young spinner Manav Suthar, while stressing the need for bowling discipline, especially concerning no-balls. Upcoming Test assignments loom in the 2026-27 World Test Championship cycle.

title: How Indians are unlocking value of idle gold sitting in their lockers
content: What is changing is what a younger generation wants it to do with idle gold. For some, the jewellery in the locker is no longer something to preserve indefinitely. It can become a house, an education, a business or an investment.

title: Uber layoffs: 3,300 jobs cut, CEO Dara Khosrowshahi says 'this is a lot of change'
content: Uber is cutting about 3,300 jobs, roughly 10 percent of its global workforce, in its biggest restructuring since 2020. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said the layoffs remove management layers, merge delivery and engineering teams, and free up capital for Uber's robotaxi push. Manager numbers fall 20 percent and fully remote roles drop to about 1 percent. Headcount now returns to 2021 levels. Khosrowshahi did not blame AI for the cuts.

title: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora has advice for companies investing billions in AI
content: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora urges urgent modernization of digital defenses.  He states that $1 trillion in outdated systems cannot stop machine-speed attacks.  Businesses need robust cybersecurity before successfully rolling out artificial intelligence.  Arora noted that AI's impact on cybersecurity is a long-term growth driver.  This technological shift requires significant enterprise budget reallocation over time.

title: Punjab polls: BJP rules out SAD tie-up, to fight solo in all 117 seats
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party will contest all 117 Punjab Assembly seats independently.  Dr. Satish Poonia confirmed the party's decision, dismissing alliance rumors with the Shiromani Akali Dal.  He expressed concern over Punjab's drug menace and corruption issues.  The party plans a dedicated action plan to address these challenges.  Punjab's development and peace remain among the BJP's top priorities.

title: Brittany Mahomes on motherhood: How is she building a legacy for her children?
content: Brittany Mahomes delivered a powerful message about women’s leadership while accepting United WE’s inaugural Champion for Change Award at CPKC Stadium in Kansas City on May 6, 2026. Speaking as a mother, entrepreneur, investor and sports owner, she said she wants her children to see women in leadership as normal, not exceptional. Mahomes stressed that women should not merely have seats at the table, but have the power to shape the room.

title: Stan Kroenke net worth 2026: How did the Rams owner build his $24.3 billion empire?
content: Stan Kroenke is expanding his already impressive sports empire by acquiring the Los Angeles Angels. This high-stakes deal will mark the entry of Major League Baseball into his extensive collection of teams. With a staggering net worth of $24.3 billion, largely derived from real estate ventures, Kroenke's franchises have enjoyed remarkable championship success in recent years. The deal is anticipated to be completed by early 2027.

title: Coco Gauff’s family sacrifices: How did her parents help her reach Grand Slam glory?
content: Coco Gauff's parents Corey and Candi Gauff made significant life changes for her tennis aspirations. They relocated the family and sacrificed careers to support her development and education. This unwavering belief and dedication formed the foundation of her eventual Grand Slam triumph. After her Wimbledon breakthrough, her family helped her manage the intense spotlight and pressure. Their continuous support ensured Coco maintained perspective and stayed grounded throughout her career.

title: From cafes to locked flats: How a Noida couple built a 100+ theft trail
content: Noida police arrested three individuals for an inter-district theft gang. The accused allegedly targeted locked flats and stole valuables from housing societies. Police recovered cash, jewellery, and electronic devices from the arrested suspects. The gang members reportedly wore masks and caps to avoid CCTV detection. Investigators are now working to identify other gang members and trace stolen goods.

title: World war 2: The deadliest conflict in human history ended 81 years ago today
content: Eighty-one years ago, on September 2, 1945, the curtains fell on World War II, the most devastating conflict in history. Triggered by Nazi Germany's invasion of Poland in 1939, this global war escalated when Japan attacked Pearl Harbor, drawing the United States into the fray. The tide turned with the Allied forces’ victories, leading to Germany's surrender in May 1945.

title: Bay Area luxury home sales surge 39% as AI boom creates new wealth
content: High-income earners in the AI sector are driving luxury home sales nationwide.  These affluent buyers are less sensitive to rising mortgage rates and property prices.  The San Francisco Bay Area shows the sharpest gains in high-end property transactions.  Potential initial public offerings for AI companies are adding urgency for buyers.  This trend indicates a divergence between the luxury and middle-market housing segments.

title: Ram Mandir's first CEO Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra (retd) has war command pedigree
content: Air Marshal Jitendra Mishra has been appointed the first CEO of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust. He commanded the Indian Air Force's Western Air Command during Operation Sindoor in May 2025. Mishra brings extensive experience from nearly four decades of service in the Indian Air Force. He is a decorated officer, having received the Sarvottam Yudh Seva Medal for his distinguished service.

title: Yolo meets SIP: How Gen Z is rewriting money rules & mistakes they should avoid
content: Gen Z is one of the more financially aware generations, focusing on financial independence and investing rather than just saving. YOLO? Sure. But Gen Z is also thinking, “How do I make my money work for me?”

title: English cricket team take u-turn after backlash, confirm rape acquitted cricketer won't represent club
content: In response to fan backlash, Hampshire Cricket has decided to withdraw Scott Kuggeleijn from their roster. The club faced significant criticism over his past allegations. Acknowledging the supporters' concerns, Hampshire confirmed that Kuggeleijn will no longer play for the team. As they currently sit at the bottom of the County Championship, their primary goal is to ensure they maintain their Division One status.

title: Manipur assembly passes third resolution seeking NRC update before census
content: The Manipur Assembly passed a resolution urging the Centre to update the National Register of Citizens. This is the third such resolution adopted by the assembly since 2022. The Centre deferred the census exercise in Manipur after a high-level meeting. This decision was taken considering the feelings and aspirations of the people. Protests continued demanding a clear roadmap for updating the NRC.

title: 'I love playing Test cricket': After Duleep Trophy heroics, Tilak Varma opens up on his India ambition
content: Tilak Varma aims to represent India in Test cricket, demonstrating a profound love for red-ball formats. His impressive batting skills have propelled South Zone to the Duleep Trophy final. Varma emphasizes his innate connection to red-ball cricket, actively seeking opportunities to enhance his domestic game. The upcoming challenge awaits as South Zone prepares to face East Zone in the final showdown of the Duleep Trophy.

title: ‘Russian skies dangerous’: Zelenskyy warns airlines as Ukraine steps up drone attacks
content: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has issued a stark warning to airlines and insurers regarding the rising dangers present in Russian airspace. The surge in drone operations penetrating deep into Russian territory introduces significant new risks. Aviation risk assessment firms project a continual pattern of Ukrainian strikes within Russia extending to 2026. Civilian aircraft remain vulnerable to military actions, raising concerns despite Ukraine's reassurances.

title: ‘Sita’s character greater than Ram’s’: DKS urges women to take leadership roles
content: In a strong endorsement of women's contributions, Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar praised their resilience and sacrifices, claiming Sita's character in the Ramayana surpasses that of Rama. He called for enhanced involvement of women entrepreneurs in state development, ensuring government support through empowerment schemes. His remarks underlined women's extraordinary abilities in both the domestic sphere and the business world.

title: From FICV to XM30: Nations race to build the next armoured battlefield beast
content: Armies worldwide are replacing Cold War-era infantry fighting vehicles with modern designs. India's DRDO is developing advanced armored platforms to replace its Sarath vehicles. The US Army is receiving prototypes for its XM30 Mechanized Infantry Combat Vehicle. Other nations like the UK, Russia, and Germany are also upgrading their armored fleets. These new vehicles offer enhanced firepower, protection, and mobility for modern warfare.

title: Uber lays off 3,300 employees as it restructures for faster growth
content: Uber is cutting approximately ten percent of its global workforce, impacting about thirty-three hundred employees. This major restructuring aims to reduce management layers and simplify company operations. Resources will be reallocated towards core ride-hailing, delivery, and robotaxi businesses. The company is also tightening remote-work policies, requiring most staff to return to offices. These changes are intended to foster growth and innovation in key areas.

title: T J Marce, 74, braves -20C cold and 65 kmph winds to climb Mt Elbrus
content: At the age of 74, T.J. Marce from Wayanad has etched his name in history by reaching the summit of Mount Elbrus, Europe’s highest peak, standing at 5,642 meters. His incredible achievement on August 15, 2026, under harsh conditions makes him the eldest Indian to conquer this formidable mountain. Marce, alongside M.P. Muraleedharan, previously scaled Mount Kilimanjaro, showcasing their inspiring passion for mountaineering even after retirement.

title: Kargil war veteran attempts suicide after 24-year wait for promised land grant
content: A Kargil War veteran attempted suicide after being denied a meeting. He sought intervention for a land grant pending over twenty-four years. The veteran was injured during the Kargil War and promised land recognition. He was reportedly blocked by police from meeting the deputy chief minister. This incident highlights the veteran's long-pending demand for promised land.

title: Jailer 2 release date confirmed: Rajinikanth film set for October 15
content: The makers of Jailer 2 have officially announced that the film will be released on October 15, 2026, putting to rest any doubts about delays. Fans can look forward to this highly anticipated mass entertainer just in time for Dussehra. Rajinikanth returns as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, while Anirudh Ravichander brings his musical genius to the project.

content: a fresh threat letter was allegedly circulated on social media targeting Kashmiri Pandit employees serving in the Kashmir Valley . a purported threat poster, allegedly issued by an outfit called itself the United Liberation Council (ULC) and dated august 23, contains the names, addresses and vehicle numbers of some employees .

title: Glacier collapse at 8.37am, alert at 9.15: Why Nepal sent disaster warning 38 mins late
content: a glacier collapse triggered devastating flash floods in Rasuwa on august 26 . authorities issuing a disaster alert 38 minutes after the ice-rock avalanche . the deadly floods have killed thousands and several remain missing .

title: EAM Jaishankar to visit Ukraine, Poland from Sept 3-5
content: the talks are expected to focus on bilateral ties, regional developments and issues of mutual interest . title: Indiana Dunes lodge reopens after 50 years, with a time capsule found inside
content: the Good Fellow Youth Camp, which ran from 1941 to 1975, provided generations of young people with an opportunity to get outdoors in what would later become Indiana Dunes National Park . a century after the lodge opened its doors, the historic building is once again open for visitors . the reopening has an unexpected link to the past thanks to a long-forgotten time capsule found hidden within its walls .

title: Teacher's welding dream turns into North Dakota's 32-mile giant sculpture highway
content: former teacher and school principal has been using scrap metal to create gigantic works of art along the Enchanted Highway in southwestern north Dakota . he used giant sculptures to draw travelers off Interstate 94 and into his struggling community .
